ownership_chain.builder_source: FoundationProject record — persists the 12-field split-total partition (see persisted_total_fields). grand_total is computed, not persisted. total_brick_cost and total_fill_cost are subsets of total_wall_cost and are NEVER summed into the section total (would double-count walls).
ownership_chain.calculator: foundationCalc.js calcProject() — owns live quantity/cost math; totals.grand_total = core calculated subtotal (excludes signage cabinets + landscape).
ownership_chain.editor_save_owner: FoundationEstimator.jsx — sectionTotal = calc.totals.grand_total + total_signage_cabinet_cost + total_landscape_cost (null-propagating); recordBuilderSave persists split totals + pushes live_total_snapshot/live_customer_price_snapshot onto the linked estimate line.
ownership_chain.source_total_derivation: builderService.sourceProjectTotal foundation branch — direct finite grand_total wins, else the shared FOUNDATION_RECORD_TOTAL_FIELDS 12-field sum; candidate extraction makes that field list the single definition used by both sourceProjectTotal and the new foundationRecordSavedTotal.
ownership_chain.display_surfaces: FoundationTotals.jsx / FoundationBOM.jsx — display only; FoundationBOM.materialTotal is a materials-scoped subtotal, NOT the section total; neither computes an authoritative total.
ownership_chain.estimate: AllInOneEstimate.line_items — total_snapshot + customer_price_snapshot = accepted/FROZEN values; live_total_snapshot + live_customer_price_snapshot = current recalculated values. Frozen values change only on explicit price acceptance.
ownership_chain.sync: useSectionSync.refreshSectionSnapshots — refreshes live_* snapshots from source totals; compares with 0.005 tolerance.
ownership_chain.estimate_ui_pattern: ProductRow.jsx — precedent UI comparing frozen vs live internal+customer values at 0.005 tolerance; the new advisory reuses this tolerance.
ownership_chain.pricing_consumers: aioPricing.js builds estimate pricing from ACCEPTED customer unit prices; customerQuote.js builds quote rows from accepted/adjusted section pricing; workOrderConversion.js seeds WO products from frozen pricing sections and resolves converted amount via pricing waterfall -> estimate quote_total -> accepted snapshot sum.

pricing_precedence.ladder: pricing engine config > applied saved customer-tier snapshot (applied===true + numeric total) > customer_price_override > customer_markup_percent
pricing_precedence.engine_ladder_documented: machine override > part fixed price > part tier/markup > customer tier > global default; chart-row specificity inside tier layers
rules: positive override beats markup; override 0 falls back to markup
applied saved tier snapshot replaces manual sell price, internal cost unchanged
tier applied without numeric saved total -> manual baseline
engaged foundation engine config owns sell side over tier and manual; empty engine context resolves back to override
editing markup/override in CustomerPricingPanel patches customer_pricing.applied=false (returns section to manual pricing)
pricing_precedence.evidence: baseline/customerPricing.js sourceProjectEconomics lines 55-89 (foundation branch); 38-case model harness asserts each rule

candidate_changes.changes: exports FOUNDATION_RECORD_TOTAL_FIELDS (the 12-field persisted partition) and foundationRecordSavedTotal(record) — direct finite grand_total wins, else 12-field sum, else null for never-priced records; sourceProjectTotal foundation branch refactored to consume the shared list. Byte-identical totals for every record shape (model-verified parity).

imports foundationRecordSavedTotal; computes savedSectionTotal from the acknowledged saved source project; passes savedSectionTotal + live sectionTotal into FoundationTotals. Advisory only — no save-path behavior change. External-agent Save-As-Copy + template-disable changes preserved.

accepts savedSectionTotal + sectionTotal; renders an advisory [role=status] strip when |current - saved| > 0.005 (up/down arrows, absolute delta, 'Save to update the estimate'); renders 'Saved $X — current pricing unavailable' when live total unavailable; renders nothing for never-priced records. Never blocks editing/saving.

imports foundationHasEnginePricing; shows a precedence note when an applied saved tier (numeric total differing >0.005 from manual baseline) shadows markup/override, and a separate engine-precedence note when engine config is engaged; suppresses notes when no precedence applies, tier unapplied/unsaved, or tier equals baseline. Manual calculation display unchanged.
